settings.simulateErrorsHint: 1 in 5 actions fail, so you can see the error states.
settings.resetBody: This puts the sample office in this browser back as it was at the start. It deletes everything that you added to the office, such as projects, tasks, messages and files. It undoes every change that you made to the office, also to your name, language and notification choices. The Simulate errors switch and your view choices, such as list or board, stay. You cannot undo it.
settings.resetDone: The sample data is back to its start state.
